description: Diagram showing representative jobs created and lost by big business, 2013–2014: downward arrow for Job Losses (Barclays -12,000, Merck -8,500, JP Morgan -8,000, Wells Fargo -6,000, Bank of America -4,200, IBM -3,020, Aetna -3,000, Eli Lilly -1,600, AIG -1,500) and upward arrow for Job Gains (Kroger +7,000, Toys R Us +6,750, Caterpillar +3,500, AT&T +3,000, Amazon.com +2,500, Motorola +2,000, CarMax +1,200, Ford +1,200, Nissan +1,000)
